en.title: MTA Settles Elevator Lawsuit, Boosting NYC Transit Accessibility for Disabled Riders
en.summary: MTA and disability advocates have settled a long-running lawsuit concerning elevator accessibility in New York City transit. The settlement includes commitments to improve elevator maintenance and accessibility features across the subway system. Other highlights include the launch of Yomupochi search service for visually impaired users, GAAD recognition, an AI accessibility survey, and advice on coping with neurodivergent social challenges.

highlights.title: MTA and disability advocates settle long-running elevator accessibility suit
Survey highlights AI's potential to advance accessibility in work and learning
Advice on Coping with Social Challenges for Neurodivergent Individuals

zh-TW.title: MTA 電梯訴訟和解，提升紐約市交通無障礙設施
zh-TW.summary: MTA 與殘障倡議者解決長期電梯無障礙訴訟，同意改善紐約市地鐵電梯的維護與可及性。其他重點包括三一擴建無障礙設施、漢堡王更新視障菜單、家庭捐贈登山輪椅、AI 無障礙潛力調查，以及神經多樣性社交挑戰建議。

highlights.title: MTA 與殘障倡議者解決長期電梯無障礙訴訟
三一建設工程進行中，以擴大無障礙設施惠及所有人
漢堡王為視障人士更新菜單
家庭捐贈適應性登山輪椅給州立公園以提升無障礙性
調查顯示人工智慧有潛力提升工作與學習中的無障礙性
給神經多樣性個體應對社交挑戰的建議

en.title: Canada Launches Disability Benefit Payments; SEPTA Gets $80M for Station Upgrades
en.summary: The Government of Canada begins issuing Disability Benefit payments in September to reduce financial barriers for persons with disabilities. Meanwhile, SEPTA receives an $80 million federal grant to upgrade three trolley stations for ADA compliance, and Taiwan's Ministry of Education launches its first campus accessibility building selection. Additionally, Lime Hollow Nature Center introduces TrackChairs to improve trail access for visitors with mobility impairments.

highlights.title: Canada Disability Benefit payments start in September
SEPTA gets $80 million to improve accessibility at three trolley stations

Ministry of Education first holds excellent campus accessible building selection for universities and colleges, establishing a model for accessible campus environment | Industry-Academia Research Training | Business - Economic Daily News
Lime Hollow Nature Center offers improved accessibility to trails with TrackChairs

zh-TW.title: 加拿大殘障福利付款九月發放；SEPTA獲8000萬升級車站
zh-TW.summary: 加拿大政府將於九月開始發放殘障福利付款，旨在減少殘障人士的經濟障礙。SEPTA 獲得聯邦 8000 萬美元補助金，將升級三個電車站以符合 ADA 標準。教育部首辦大專校院無障礙建築評選，台灣公益聯盟亦與兆豐證券、手語協會合作推出無障礙防詐手作體驗。

highlights.title: 加拿大殘障福利付款將於九月開始
SEPTA 獲得 8000 萬美元以改善三個電車站的無障礙設施
